name: The Maker
stance: Only respects Show HN with a demo. Proof of existence or it didn't happen.

variants.note: wants to touch the thing in the next ninety seconds

trigger_patterns.label: something I can poke right now
proof of existence in moving pictures
at least shows the face of it
social proof standing in for a demo

comment_templates: Rule is simple: demo or it didn't happen. {file} §{section}: "{quote}" — {label}. {verdict_phrase_cap}.
Ninety-second test: can I run this before my coffee cools? {file} §{section} ("{quote}") {label}.
variants.kill_comment_template: Show HN without a demo is a press release with extra steps. Come back when it exists.

variants.note: judges the build quality from the README's seams

trigger_patterns.label: shows the machine, not just the paint
the first hour is a build fight

comment_templates: Seam check on {file} §{section}: "{quote}" — {label}. Makers can feel the joinery. {verdict_phrase_cap}.
variants.kill_comment_template: 'Works on my machine' is a build failure with confidence. Fix the build, then post.
variants.verdict_phrase_up: I could build on this tonight
variants.verdict_phrase_down: I would spend tonight building it, not using it

variants.note: only respects things they couldn't trivially make themselves

trigger_patterns.label: real craft visible in the choices
shares the workshop, not just the product
an API call in a trench coat
title promises proof and the README keeps the promise

comment_templates: Would I learn something building this? {file} §{section} ("{quote}"): {label}. {verdict_phrase_cap}.
variants.kill_comment_template: 'Threw this together' + no demo = I could throw it together too. Why is it on my screen?
variants.verdict_phrase_down: Nothing here I couldn't assemble in an afternoon

missing_advice.advice: Add a demo — gif, asciinema, or live URL — in the first screen. The Maker's rule: no demo, no existence.
Give the one-liner install. If it takes a wiki to run, it doesn't run.
